exposure: Expected vs. unexpected placenta accreta spectrum
outcome: Number of red blood cell units transfused
cohort: 243 patients with histologically proven placenta accreta spectrum deliveries at a single academic referral center between January 1, 2011, and June 30, 2018
finding: Contrary to previous findings, this study found better outcomes in the expected placenta accreta spectrum group, suggesting that a multidisciplinary approach and ongoing process improvement may contribute to better maternal morbidity outcomes in placenta accreta spectrum cases.
